interest: Index on Japan's 1939 New Year holiday closures.
overview: Docket (1939): Grew reports Japanese government offices closing for New Year, suspending substantive diplomatic business.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers docket sheet cataloguing incoming telegrams concerning Japanese New Year holidays and government office closures.
subfiles.summary: Lists Grew's telegrams on Japan's 1939-40 New Year office closures, which would halt substantive diplomatic business.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Holidays in Japan
